Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact bottom tool dock from original region16,768,358,56 normalized. Three external surfaces left-to-right: circular SEARCH button; elongated INPUT pill; circular COMPOSE button. Exact only Japanese text in input: 入力して質問, Meiryo REGULAR40014px/24px,tracking0, secondarygray. ORIGINAL controls all glyphs: search clean circular lens/short diagonalhandle; inside input at LEFT restore the ORIGINAL black Notion-assistant line-drawn face/mark in its tiny white circle, exactly as reference (mock omitted it), then Japanese placeholder, at RIGHT source microphone with capsule/stem/base proportions; right compose is ORIGINAL square outline with diagonal pencil crossing upper-right edge, NOT mock's bare pencil. Preserve original assistant artwork/black lines, no replacement star/robot/new logo. Supporting search/mic/compose use coherent slate#526173 stroke and source optical proportions. All three surfaces white with fine neutral outline and soft downward shadows on pure-white canvas, source floating hierarchy without gray/mint ambient fill. No selected/enabled state color, no invented primarygreen action or decorativeaccent. Keep compact358px logical width/56px overallheight, input dominates width, uniformly enlarged into readable wide1536x512 with restrained margin. No source page, phone, additional labels or controls.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No added accent justified for balanced neutral dock. Preserve black assistant artwork; other supporting glyphs coherent slate, all surfaces white.
